samples.xml_description:
<module id="fixed_point_adder">
    <description>A parameterized fixed-point adder for performing arithmetic operations with fixed precision.</description>
    
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[N-1:0]">First N-bit fixed-point input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[N-1:0]">Second N-bit fixed-point input operand.</input>
        <output id="c" width_description="[N-1:0]">N-bit output representing the result of the fixed-point addition.</output>
    </ports>
    
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="Q">Number of fractional bits (precision).</param>
        <param id="N">Total number of bits, including integer and fractional parts.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    
    <implementation>
        reg signed[N-1:0] res;
        
        always @(a,b) begin
            if ((a[N-1]==b[N-1])) // Same sign (+ve/-ve)
                res = {a[N-1],(a[N-2:0]+b[N-2:0])};
            
            else if ((a[N-1]!=b[N-1])) // Different signs
                if (a > b) begin
                    res = {a[N-1],(a[N-2:0]-b[N-2:0])};  // Result = +ve
                end
                
                else if (a < b) begin
                    res = {b[N-1],(b[N-2:0]-a[N-2:0])};  // Result = -ve
                    res[N-2]=0;
                end
                
                else begin
                    res = {(N){1'b0}};     // Result = Zero
                end
            
            $display("res=%d\n",res);
        end
        
        assign c = res;
    </implementation>
</module>
